'''Othon City''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirin]].

[[Minas Derel]] worked in this city during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She delivered [[Sector Permit]]s for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] active in the [[Locris sector/Legends|Locris sector]].
